plugins.prepareCmd: cd frontend && npm version ${nextRelease.version} --no-git-tag-version && cd .. && sed -i 's/version="[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"/version="${nextRelease.version}"/g' backend/app/main.py && sed -i 's/"version": "[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"/"version": "${nextRelease.version}"/g' backend/app/main.py && sed -i 's/== "[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"/== "${nextRelease.version}"/g' backend/tests/test_release_info.py
